answer: Each identity begins as a lone sparrow that must cross open water to reach a shared island of verified agents. Arrival requires depositing a bond into a common lagoon that only unlocks after peers from distinct lineages attest its work for several epochs. A farm of clones still needs one bond and one crossing per identity; the lagoon slash on collusion makes the cost linear and non-poolable, while a single honest agent pays once and keeps its standing.
